entities.summary: Alex James Burnett is an American former professional baseball right-handed relief pitcher. He is 6 feet 0 inches (1.83 m) tall and weighs 215 pounds (98 kg). He was drafted in the 12th round of the 2005 Major League Baseball draft by the Minnesota Twins.
